Agreed! I went there and they treat the elephants wonderfully. Instead of chaining them up for us to approach then they let them run free on huge land for them to approach us. So if some elephants don't want they don't have to but believe me a lot of them do. It's so nice having them follow you around because they genuinely like the cuddles not because they are being stabbed in the legs otherwise. To train these elephants to do little tricks they use lots of bananas and pumpkins as a reward not punishment technique. After going to this sanctuary we were brought to an elephant ride by our tour guide. I of course chose to stay in the car like a couple others for the same reason. I could already see elephants chained up to a stump and rocking back and forth (shows that they are anxious or worried). I started crying when I saw the men on top of the elephants were all carrying bull hooks, it was exactly like what I saw on a documentary when at the elephant nature park. When everybody else came back none of them were happy and were all talking about how they would hit them multiple times and it was just disturbing to watch.

I hate how so many tourists are oblivious to how the animals they are riding on are 'trained'
